b: Home › Legal › Children's privacy & consent Children's Privacy Notice & Parental Consent A plain-language notice for parents and guardians, and the consent we ask for before a child takes part in any Unlock IQ programme. Why we ask for your consent Every student who takes part in AMO, REAL Olympiad, Ramanujan Maths Quiz or UNITE is under 18. Indian law (the DPDP Act, 2023) requires us to obtain verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian before processing a child's personal data. Registration is therefore always by a parent or guardian, never by the child alone. What we collect about your child Name, class and school (to run the exam and issue the certificate) Exam responses and scores (to compute results and ranks) Nothing else — no photographs, no location, no biometric data, no social profiles. What we do not do We do not track your child across the internet or serve them advertising. We do not sell or share your child's data with advertisers. We do not contact your child directly — all communication goes to the parent's registered mobile and email. We do not publish results with names, except a top-ranks list that you can opt out of at registration. Proctoring during exams Our online exams are proctored to keep them fair. This means the exam platform may take periodic snapshots via the device camera during the exam only, and record tab-switches. These are stored for 90 days for the purpose of reviewing any integrity concern, then deleted. Registration includes consent to this proctoring; if you do not agree, please do not register. Your rights as a parent You may, at any time, see the data we hold about your child, correct it, withdraw consent (which ends the child's participation), or ask us to delete it once the programme is complete. Contact our grievance officer: Mr. Swami S. , privacy@unlockiqinstitute.com . The consent we record At registration, the parent or guardian ticks a box confirming that they have read this notice and consent to the processing described. We record the time, the account and the version of this notice. For school-based registrations, the school collects the same consent on our printable form and keeps it on file.
